metadata.description: A personal Claude Code marketplace — how Claude works across one developer's repos: session flow, house rules, workflows.

plugins.name: modus
plugins.description: Core: the /modus:init command, the capture watcher skill, and the house-rules sync (rules importable from ~/.claude/modus/rules/). Enable once at user scope.

plugins.name: session-flow
plugins.description: Context-budget wrap-up guard, memory-review-after-commit nudge, and the /roadmap command for kickoff-ready task briefs. Enable per project.

plugins.name: visual-iteration
plugins.description: Playwright MCP server + the visual-iteration skill: serve scratch HTML/SVG over HTTP, tune with element screenshots. Enable per project.
